description: Japanese holidays, business-day arithmetic, statutory filing deadlines with holiday shift, wareki conversion. $0.003/call. Deterministic, cites primary sources; errors and unverified rules are never billed. Required by mode (default add): add -> from, days; between -> from, to; holidays -> year; deadline -> kind, base_date; wareki -> date.

base_date.description: Base date YYYY-MM-DD for deadline calculation

days.description: Number of business days to add

kind.description: One of: withholding_tax_monthly, social_insurance_monthly, corporate_tax, consumption_tax_corporate, income_tax_final, consumption_tax_individual, depreciable_assets, legal_records. Statutory deadline kind (see enum)

mode.description: Required by mode (default add): add -> from, days; between -> from, to; holidays -> year; deadline -> kind, base_date; wareki -> date.

saturday_off.description: Treat Saturdays as non-business days (default true)

x_payment.description: Optional: base64 X-PAYMENT header value (x402 exact scheme, USDC on Base mainnet). Omit it to receive the payment requirements (accepts[] + docs) for this call without being charged.

name: jp_business_days

body.description: JSON body of the underlying call (see /samples/{product} for each product's shape)

payment_required.description: true when status is 402: body holds x402 payment terms, not a result. Pay and call again with x_payment

receipt_id.description: set on paid results; free re-fetch via get_receipt

status.description: HTTP status of the underlying call (200 result, 402 payment terms, 4xx input error)
